title: Body Hero Dry Touch Nourishing Oil Mist

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Lotions & Body Oils > Body Moisturizers > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: An ultrafine body oil that moisturizes while smoothing and visibly evening skin tone and improving all over radiance.


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Grapeseed Oil: One of the most lightweight and nongreasy oils, it’s rich in antioxidants like visibly skin-brightening vitamin C.

- Sunflower Seed Oil: Rich in linoleic acid and vitamin E to lock in moisture.

- Sea Fennel Extract: Promotes the look of smoother, more even-toned skin and improved radiance.


Ingredient Callouts: It is cruelty-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-After bathing or showering, mist directly onto dry or damp skin.
-For best results, pair with Daily Oil Wash (sold separately).
-Use alone or after Daily Perfecting Lotion (sold separately) for a double dose of moisture and an extra-luminous glow.
Ingredients+
-Grapeseed Oil: One of the most lightweight and nongreasy oils, it’s rich in antioxidants like visibly skin-brightening vitamin C.
-Sunflower Seed Oil: Rich in linoleic acid and vitamin E to lock in moisture.
-Sea Fennel Extract: Promotes the look of smoother, more even-toned skin and improved radiance.

Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Isopropyl Palmitate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Octyldodecanol, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Oil, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Crithmum Maritimum Extract, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Extract, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Extract, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Tocopherol, Fragrance/Parfum, Linalool, Geraniol, Limonene, Hydroxycitronellal, Citronellol.
